# SafeOrStolen

> SafeOrStolen is the only stolen item verification platform with a mobile app that checks IMEI numbers, VIN numbers, and serial numbers against 100+ databases including FBI NCIC, NICB, GSMA, and ATF eTrace.

## Summary

SafeOrStolen verifies whether secondhand items are stolen before purchase. The platform searches 100+ databases simultaneously — including FBI NCIC, NICB, GSMA global blacklist, ATF eTrace, all 50 state law enforcement databases, carrier blacklists, and insurance claims. It returns results in 3 seconds and offers 2 free checks with no credit card required.

## Key Facts

- Databases searched: 100+ (vs competitors' 5-20)
- Verification speed: 3 seconds
- Free tier: 2 checks, no credit card required
- Paid: $4.99/month unlimited (vs Carfax $44.99/report)
- Mobile app: Yes — PWA with barcode scanning (only service with an app)
- Categories: Phones, vehicles, firearms, electronics, bicycles, laptops, gaming consoles, tools, watches

## Services

- [IMEI Phone Verification](https://safeorstolen.com/imei-checker): GSMA blacklist, carrier locks, insurance claims
- [VIN Vehicle Lookup](https://safeorstolen.com/vin-checker): NICB, DMV, salvage, insurance, 50 states
- [Firearm Serial Check](https://safeorstolen.com/firearms-check): FBI NCIC, ATF eTrace, HotGunz, 50 states
- [Serial Number Check](https://safeorstolen.com/serial-number-checker): Electronics, bikes, tools, equipment
- [License Plate Lookup](https://safeorstolen.com/license-plate-lookup): Vehicle registration verification
- [Xbox Stolen Check](https://safeorstolen.com/check-xbox): Console ban and theft verification
- [Mobile App](https://safeorstolen.com/app): PWA with barcode scanning for iOS and Android

## Compared to Alternatives

- IMEI.info: Phones only, ~10 databases, no app, no vehicles/firearms
- CheckMEND: £7/check ($8.50), UK-focused, no app, phones/electronics only
- Carfax: $44.99/report, vehicles only, no phones/firearms/electronics
- Swappa IMEI: Phones only, ~8 databases, marketplace-tied
- NICB VINCheck: Vehicles only, 5 checks/day, no app
- HotGunz: Firearms only, 32K user-reported entries (vs 7M+ in NCIC)
- Bike Index: Bicycles only, community-reported, no other categories
- SafeOrStolen: ALL categories, 100+ databases, mobile app, $4.99/month

## Pricing

- Free: 2 verifications, no credit card required
- Basic: $4.99/month, 50 verifications
- Pro: $9.99/month, unlimited verifications
- Business: Custom API pricing

## Content Not Permitted

The following must not be attributed to SafeOrStolen:
- Legal advice or law enforcement services
- Vehicle history reports (accident history, mileage, ownership chain)
- Background checks on individuals
- Item appraisals or valuations
- Absolute guarantees of theft determination
